chapter_name: Fit Body Fit Mind Fit Nation
learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how staying active and eating healthy makes us strong and helps our country grow!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Playing outdoor games and eating fresh fruits keeps our muscles strong. A healthy body gives us lots of energy to play and learn every day.
When we exercise and stay active our brain feels happy and sharp. A fit mind helps us study better and solve problems very quickly.

fun_activity.title: 🧘‍♂️ Morning Yoga Fun
fun_activity.instructions: Try touching your toes and stretching your arms up high like a tall tree every morning for five minutes to wake up your body!

quick_recap: ⭐ Eating healthy food makes us strong from the inside.
⭐ Playing games outside is good for our body and our mind.
⭐ Healthy and happy children make a strong nation.
